title: Neckpinches in a Positively Curved Market: Ricci Flow with Surgery on the Nikkei-225
abstract: arXiv:2611.25860v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the intrinsic geometry of the Nikkei-225 through the discrete Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC) of its empirical correlation graph, using the graph Ricci flow and surgery methodology of arXiv:2510.15942. The 226-node correlation graph, built from daily returns between January 2020 and June 2026, is ORC-spherical: every edge has strictly positive curvature before any flow, close to the equal-weight value $\kappa\approx0.502$. Under a fixed 20-iteration Ricci flow the curvature distribution polarises into a high-curvature bulk and a low-curvature minority, and cutting the low-curvature edges splits the graph into components of 184 and 42 nodes. The recursive ARCUS procedure (Adaptive Ricci Curvature Unsupervised Surgery) stops the flow at each node once a curvature gap ratio $G$ exceeds $G_{\min}$ and the surgery set is stable. translated_title: 正曲率市场中的“颈部捏缩”现象：日经225指数上的带手术的里奇流
translated_abstract: 我们通过日经225指数经验相关性图的离散Ollivier-Ricci曲率（ORC）来研究其内在几何结构，采用arXiv:2510.15942提出的图里奇流与手术方法。该相关性图由2020年1月至2026年6月的日收益率构建，包含226个节点，呈ORC球面特征：在任何流操作之前，每条边都具有严格正的曲率，接近等权值κ≈0.502。在固定的20次迭代里奇流作用下，曲率分布极化为高曲率主体和低曲率少数群体，切断低曲率边后图被分割为184个节点和42个节点的两个连通分量。递归的ARCUS程序（自适应里奇曲率无监督手术）在每个节点处，一旦曲率间隙比G超过G_min且手术集合保持稳定，就停止流演化。在G_min=10且最小聚类规模为15的条件下，ARCUS在13个层级上共执行了28次手术，最终结束于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将Ollivier-Ricci曲率、图里奇流与自适应手术方法（ARCUS）应用于日经225指数相关性图，发现市场呈现正曲率的“球面”几何结构，并能通过曲率驱动的手术自适应地将其分解为多层级社区结构。
en_tdlr: This paper applies Ollivier-Ricci curvature, graph Ricci flow, and an adaptive surgery procedure (ARCUS) to the Nikkei-225 empirical correlation graph, revealing a positively curved "ORC-spherical" market geometry and hierarchically partitioning it into community structures.
